fields.title: Distributed Systems Fundamentals
fields.body: A distributed system is a collection of independent computers that appear to users as a single coherent system. Consensus, replication, and partitioning are core concerns.

fields.title: Kafka: Distributed Streaming
fields.body: Apache Kafka is a distributed streaming platform used to build real time data pipelines. Producers write to topics and consumers read from partitions.

fields.title: RabbitMQ Message Broker
fields.body: RabbitMQ is a message broker that implements the AMQP protocol. It supports queues, exchanges, and flexible routing for asynchronous messaging.

fields.title: Python for Data Engineering
fields.body: Python is widely used for data engineering, deployment automation, and building ETL pipelines. Its ecosystem includes pandas and airflow.

fields.title: Go Concurrency Patterns
fields.body: Go provides goroutines and channels for concurrency. Worker pools and fan out fan in patterns make it easy to build distributed workers.

fields.title: Inverted Index Internals
fields.body: An inverted index maps terms to posting lists of documents. It is the core data structure behind every full text search engine and enables fast distributed search.

fields.title: Database Storage Engines
fields.body: Modern database storage engines use a write ahead log for durability and sstable files on disk. The LSM tree design powers RocksDB and Cassandra.

fields.title: BM25 Ranking Explained
fields.body: BM25 improves on TF-IDF with term frequency saturation and document length normalization. It is the default ranking function in Elasticsearch.

fields.title: Consistent Hashing
fields.body: Consistent hashing distributes keys across nodes so that adding or removing a node only reshuffles a small fraction of keys. It underlies sharding and caching layers.

fields.title: Deployment Strategies
fields.body: Blue green deployment and canary releases reduce risk. Automated deployment pipelines deploy code safely to production with rollback support.
